races.paceDynamic: Torbados is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will likely take them along at a sustainable pace without pressure. Space Moon may press from a prominent position but lacks the confirmed pace-setting credentials. With 9 of the 12 runners showing hold-up tendencies, this sets up as a slow-burn affair with plenty of cover for patient riders. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finish, while early leaders and prominent racers face the tactical disadvantage of making their own running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Favours Finishers
scenarios.trigger: If Torbados sets an uncontested lead with Space Moon tracking
scenarios.body: The pace will be pedestrian through the early stages, setting up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to unleash finishing kicks. Patient riders on horses like Sparkling Pink and Maximum Velocity can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Torbados Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and no sustained pressure develops
scenarios.body: Torbados could steal a march turning for home while the hold-up horses are still getting organized behind the wall of horses. His prominent racing style gives him first run on rivals who need the race to develop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge in the straight
scenarios.body: Several runners will get hampered or find no room at crucial moments, leaving a clear run for those finding daylight. The race becomes about luck in running rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pressure Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If Space Moon or another prominent runner challenges Torbados early
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle could develop, changing the complexion and potentially setting it up for a different type of finisher. This would bring stamina into play over the 7f trip.

races.paceDynamic: Hallandale Beach is the sole confirmed front-runner in this field and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (Sanny Doo, Time To Take Off, Tickhill Flyer, Aurora's Doublesix) and four lightly-raced unknowns (Manatee Mehmas, Lady Grey, You Mystify Me), the pace will be moderate to steady through the early stages. The sprint finish will likely develop from 2f out as the hold-up horses unleash their challenges down the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can time their runs, while front-running Hallandale Beach faces the classic 5f dilemma of sustainable pace versus kick-back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and multiple hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: Time To Take Off and Sanny Doo can utilise their proven tactical speed from off the pace. The moderate early gallop allows them to conserve energy for strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Hallandale Beach maintains a workable lead without being headed in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows sustainable fractions that hold off late challenges. Cieren Fallon can dictate ideal splits without interference from pace rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the four lightly-raced horses shows significant improvement from their debut efforts
scenarios.body: The tactical race setup suits unexposed types who can travel well before producing untapped acceleration. Class relief from higher-rated stables could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Hallandale Beach goes too slowly early and multiple horses sprint simultaneously from 2f out
scenarios.body: A messy, bunched finish develops where the horse with the best turn of foot wins regardless of tactics. Minor form horses can capitalise on the tactical lottery.

Hallandale Beach must avoid going too fast early as the lone leader, with Cieren Fallon needing to judge sustainable fractions perfectly
Time To Take Off carries 132lbs but has James Doyle aboard, suggesting connections believe the class drop outweighs the weight penalty

races.paceDynamic: Dreamasar and Golden Muse will both want to lead from the gates, creating immediate pressure in a small field where natural pace is limited. Dreamasar has been off 201 days but showed front-running ability when winning at Salisbury, while Golden Muse has won her last two starts wire-to-wire including at this trip. The prominent runners Rockin' The Boat, Naga and Amora Queen will likely settle just behind this early duel, with only Vilaine Verlaine racing from the rear. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and closers, as the early pace battle between the two leaders should set up a strong gallop that will find them out late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Clash Early
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamasar and Golden Muse engage in a prolonged speed duel through halfway
scenarios.body: Both front-runners will compromise each other's finishing kick, allowing the prominent settlers to strike late. Rockin' The Boat and Naga are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Muse or Dreamasar establishes an uncontested lead by the first bend
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets an easy time of it and proves hard to peg back up the Doncaster straight. Golden Muse's recent winning form gives her the edge if this unfolds.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are restrained early creating a crawling pace through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. Naga's class edge and Silky Lass's light weight become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Vilaine Verlaine gets the perfect setup with a strong even gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up mare can time her challenge perfectly from the back as others tire. Her trainer Mark Usher's 1/6 strike rate suggests she's well placed for a big effort.

races.paceDynamic: Lopeo, Director's Cut, and Alba Gu Brath will ensure a relentless gallop from the start over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip. With three confirmed front-runners in a small field, the early pace will be fierce as they jostle for position, creating a true staying test. The sustained gallop will drain the speed reserves of the leaders while setting up the race perfectly for horses with tactical pace who can close strongly. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can time their challenge late when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will leave Lopeo, Director's Cut and Alba Gu Brath vulnerable in the final furlong as their stamina reserves empty. Hold-up horses Sailor Song and Stoneacre Donny can exploit the collapse with perfectly timed late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Gu Brath or Director's Cut can steal a march on their pace rivals
scenarios.body: The winner breaks clear of the other front-runners at the 3f pole and maintains just enough in reserve to hold off late challengers. Their superior tactical positioning allows them to dictate terms when it matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Times Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Al Azd or Shushi can track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: Sitting in fourth or fifth position allows them to have the best of both worlds - close enough to strike but avoiding the early speed battle. They can pick off tiring leaders while having more left than the hold-up horses who need too much late ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Proves Moderate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners settle into a rhythm rather than fight
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more manageable, allowing the leaders to conserve energy for a sprint finish. This negates the tactical advantage of the hold-up horses and plays to pure speed at the finish.

races.paceDynamic: Something and the front-running style of both leaders creates a contested early pace over this demanding 1m4f trip at Doncaster. With only these two confirmed pace-setters in an 8-runner field, they'll likely settle into an honest rhythm after the initial skirmishing, creating a true gallop that will test stamina reserves. The sustained pace will draw the field along, setting up the race for those with tactical speed and finishing kick. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven staying power who can capitalize on the pace-setters' efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Something and the early pace creates an honest gallop that stretches the field
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo will set up perfectly for closers with tactical speed who can pick off tired leaders in the final two furlongs. Horses like Maghlaak and Charmaine with proven finishing kicks will find themselves in the ideal position.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Something Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Something can dictate terms without serious early pressure and maintain reserves
scenarios.body: The lightly-weighted leader can control the tempo and kick away from his rivals when it matters, using his front-running style to maximum advantage. His recent form suggests he's capable of wire-to-wire success if allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between horses who settled well off the pace, with Kimeko Glory and Machete potentially benefiting from a messy, stop-start gallop. This scenario suits horses who can quicken from anywhere but requires the pace to completely fall apart.

races.paceDynamic: Union Island and Pretty Spirited are the only prominent runners in a field dominated by hold-up horses, creating a pedestrian early gallop that will suit patient types. With minimal early pressure, the pace-setters can dictate terms through steady fractions before the field bunches for a sprint finish. Fire Eyes, Siam Fox, Mariner, and Pisanello all possess the tactical speed to quicken off this tempo. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with finishing kicks who can exploit the likely modest early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Kick Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island and Pretty Spirited set uncontested fractions through the first half
scenarios.body: The field will close up turning for home creating a bunched sprint finish that rewards horses with the best turn of foot. Hold-up horses with proven finishing speed can time their runs perfectly off the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If several hold-up horses move together approaching the turn to increase the tempo
scenarios.body: The injection of pace will stretch the field and favour horses that can sustain their effort rather than those needing a sprint finish. This benefits the more genuine stayers among the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island and Pretty Spirited go too fast early trying to steal a march
scenarios.body: Both pace-setters will weaken in the final furlong leaving the race to the first wave of closers. Patient hold-up horses with tactical speed can sweep past the faltering leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island gets an easy lead and maintains a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The consistent pace will prevent a cavalry charge finish and reward the horse that travels best in the lead. Pretty Spirited could also benefit from tracking the leader.
